name: ui-contour
meaning: Code-first scope: full UI ring (create, resource load, resize, update, render, input, open/close). Walk original methods with dependencies; do not jump to gameplay. Library CEGUI/OGRE internals are a fixed boundary, not rewritten.
library_boundary: CEGUI 0.6.2 + OGRE 1.6.5 behavior from the pinned vendor/library version is reused at the boundary; changes to bundled library behavior are tracked separately.
first_packet: scale + inventory open: 0x00a83ed0 family (boundary exists) then 0x00b4eb70 + 0x00b569e0 as one coupled packet with a shared field map.
